map.创业团队股权分配，支持加权贡献、期权池预留与多轮融资稀释: Startup team equity allocation with weighted contribution, option pool reservation and multi-round dilution
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：amount ÷ (pre + amount) ×: Core formula (by input variable): amount / (pre + amount) x 100; max(0, min(100, t.initPct))
map.按各创始人对 Idea/资金/时间/资源 的贡献打分，股权 = 个人得分 ÷ 总: Score each founder's contribution to the idea, capital, time and resources, then equity = individual score / total score x (100% - option pool), avoiding an arbitrary even split or shares based only on capital contributed.
map.先扣除期权池（如 10%）再分配创始股，确保池子在创始人之「上层」预留，后续融资: Deduct the option pool (such as 10%) first, then allocate founder shares, so the pool sits above the founders and dilutes proportionally with them in later funding rounds.
map.每轮融资按「保留比例 = 投前 ÷ (投前 + 本轮)」稀释现有股东，投资人持股: Each round dilutes existing shareholders via "retained percentage = pre-money / (pre-money + new amount)", and the investor stake = new amount / (pre-money + new amount), so multi-round structures can be derived step by step.
map.可复现算例（A60/B40 分，期权池 10%，一轮 pre=1000 万 am: Reproducible example (A60/B40 split, 10% option pool, round 1 pre=10,000,000 CNY, amount=5,000,000 CNY)
map.创始可分配 = 100% − 10% = 90%：A = 60/100 × 90:
Distributable to founders = 100% - 10% = 90%: A = 60/100 x 90% = 54.0%, B = 36.0%, option pool 10% (total 100%).
Round 1: post-money = 10,000,000 + 5,000,000 = 15,000,000 CNY, retained percentage = 10,000,000/15,000,000 = 0.6667, investor stake = 5,000,000/15,000,000 x 100% = 33.33%.
After dilution: A = 54 x 0.6667 = 36.00%, B = 24.00%, pool = 6.67%, investor 33.33% (total 100%). Further rounds can be layered on.
map.期权池该放哪一层？: Which level should the option pool sit at?
map.放在创始人分配「之前」（即先扣 10% 池子，剩余 90% 分给创始人）。这样后: Place it before founder allocation (deduct the 10% pool first, distribute the remaining 90% to founders). That way later financing dilutes the pool and the founders proportionally, avoiding a separately reserved pool that would dilute founders twice.
map.多轮融资后股权怎么算？: How is equity computed after multiple rounds?
map.每一轮都用「保留比例 = 投前估值 ÷ (投前 + 本轮金额)」乘到现有各方比例: In each round multiply every existing party's percentage by "retained percentage = pre-money valuation / (pre-money + new amount)", then add the investors at "new amount / post-money". Stacking rounds one by one shows the final structure of founders, pool and each round of investors.
